“Not too bad,”

“He has strength close to the Tenth Stage Martial Tao.”

Through that statue, Lin Yuan roughly understood the Black Demon Pavilion Master’s strength.

You should know that tens of thousands of years ago, during the heyday of the Ancestral Demon Tree, its strength was only at the Seventh Rank, yet the Pavilion Master possessed power close to the Tenth Rank. No wonder he could strike awe into the collective Evil Gods.

But for Lin Yuan now, this was naturally far from enough.

...

In terms of life level, Lin Yuan was also at the Ninth Stage Peak.

However, Lin Yuan’s Ninth Stage Peak was not the same as a normal Ninth Stage Peak; in critical moments, he could even burst forth with the power of Tier 11.

Moreover, what Lin Yuan faced now was not the true body of the Black Demon Pavilion’s Master, but a statue formed from the condensation of power.

Boom.

In front of ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream,’ the statue emanated a black fog.

The black fog was endless, quickly enveloping an area of hundreds of thousands of miles.

“Break,”

Standing firm in the void, Lin Yuan, in comparison to the two colossal Foreign Evil Gods, seemed like an insignificant speck of dust, but as he raised his right hand, his index finger pointed lightly.

The endless black mist spread by the terrifying statue rapidly thinned and dissipated, even the statue itself shook, its surface showing cracks rapidly spreading, before ultimately crashing down.

Without the protection of the statue,

‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ was exposed once again.

“What? The statue of power bestowed by the Pavilion Master was directly shattered? I still had one more chance to activate it…”

‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ couldn’t believe it. The Black Demon Pavilion Master’s strength was unquestionable, and a statue containing his power should have been more than capable of sweeping through many Foreign Evil Gods.

But now, the statue that it pinned its hopes on turned out to be as fragile as thin paper.

“Hmm?”

With a thought from Lin Yuan, space subtly undulated, and the statue appeared in his hand.

If it weren’t for him holding back, that strike could have shattered the statue. However, Lin Yuan wanted to use the statue to glimpse into the Black Demon Pavilion Master.

It wasn’t that he placed much importance on the Pavilion Master; rather, abilities and talents held by such level Foreign Evil Gods, as well as their inherent essence, piqued Lin Yuan’s curiosity.

And with his understanding of the causality and fusion rules, he could easily lock onto the exact location of the Black Demon Pavilion Master through the statue.

Whether it was ‘Magic Eye’ or ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’,

both were acting under the orders of the Black Demon Pavilion Master to invade Tianqing World, and Lin Yuan would not let the mastermind behind the scenes go unpunished.

Rustle rustle.

Pocketing the statue, Lin Yuan looked towards ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ who was still rooted to the spot, and pointed out once more.

Rustle rustle.

Without the statue’s protection, ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ was utterly defenseless against the might of Lin Yuan’s pointed finger; in an instant, 90% of ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’s’ body vaporized, as the terrifying force continued, suppressing the most core part.

“How are you so strong?”

‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ trembled internally. With just a raise of his hand, it had completely lost its ability to resist. This kind of power, even the Black Demon Pavilion Master couldn’t be much stronger, could he?

Even in ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’s’ view, if compared to Lin Yuan at this moment, even the powerful Pavilion Master might seem inferior.

But how could that be?

The Black Demon Pavilion Master, an entity that could bring forth life with a word, one who isn’t born but devours many worlds, even Foreign Evil Gods, to establish his fame?

But before ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ could respond, its core was suppressed, its consciousness quickly slipping into slumber, before ultimately falling into Lin Yuan’s hands.

“Is this the core of that Evil God?”

Lin Yuan looked at the clump of fog before him, inspecting it closely.

“I’ll study it later.”

Lin Yuan immediately packed away the fog.

He didn’t kill ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ as he wanted to thoroughly study this Foreign Evil God.

In the past, Lin Yuan didn’t have the strength to rival the Ancestral Demon Tree without great effort. Now, having returned to the Boundless Void, he surely wouldn’t miss the opportunity.

In the Main Universe, Lin Yuan studied the physical structures and soul essences of the Myriad Clans’ Powerhouses, particularly those unique lives and their talents.

Under a multitude of conditions, it enabled Lin Yuan to create the most complete Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

In the Boundless Void, those Foreign Evil Gods that fed on worlds were, to Lin Yuan, no worse than those unique creatures of the Main Universe.

These Foreign Evil Gods possessed all sorts of bizarre abilities, which could be greatly beneficial to Lin Yuan’s understanding of this part of the Boundless Void.

This return had two goals for Lin Yuan.

One was to grasp as many conventional fusion rules as possible, especially the Five-Layered Realm of Space-Time Fusion Rules.

The other was to explore the Boundless Void, as well as those Foreign Evil Gods.

Capturing ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ was in service of the second goal.

…

The statue of the Black Demon Pavilion Master was brought down, followed swiftly by the suppression of ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream,’ which fell into Lin Yuan’s hands.

It seemed to take a long time, but in reality, it was exceedingly brief; from the beginning to the end, it was nothing more than a single breath.

Elsewhere,

The giant eyeball ‘Magic Eye’ was completely dumbfounded, real fear surging within.

‘Myriad Tentacle Stream,’ an entity equal in power to it, was gone just like that? Even the activation of the Pavilion Master’s gifted statue provided no resistance.

“Why was such a strong entity not mentioned before?”

The giant eyeball ‘Magic Eye’ felt an upsurge of grievance in its heart.

It had thought taking down Tianqing World would be an easy job, especially with the statue of power bestowed by the Pavilion Master in hand.

If not for wanting to minimize the cost, they could have had Tianqing World under their control much earlier.

But now, an unfathomable existence like Lin Yuan had emerged.

“Run.”

The giant eyeball ‘Magic Eye,’ sensing the small figure that dealt with ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ slowly turning its attention towards it, immediately felt its scalp go numb.
